Lina (AE): FYI - Vantage (prospect) wants to validate 'atlas-30b-mix' (community) for internal search. They want a 3-day POC, hosted preferred but may accept Dedicated. Main asks: model variant compatibility, embeddings/LLM combo, and a one-time trial discount.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Do they require long context? Customers said up to 2k. Any variant info?
Lina (AE): They uploaded a model manifest that lists: 
```
model: atlas-30b-mix
variant: mix-q5b
vocab_size: 50288
hidden: 25600
heads: 64
seq_default: 2048
license: permissive-sample
```
Mei (Inference Eng): mix-q5b quant may be custom. We'll need to validate tokenization and attention patterns. For embeddings + LLM combo we can route embeddings to a smaller encoder (atlas-2b-embed) while generative runs on atlas-30b-mix. Need to verify latency if chaining.
Alex (Security): License check + export control question: does the manifest include export restrictions? Also, hosted POC with customer data in logs needs redaction. For Dedicated, ask for network diagram.
Jules (Pricing): For a 3-day hosted trial with limited throughput we can offer a trial credit plus discounted flat for a dedicated node. Will include a clause for model validation failure.
infra-bot: Provision request created: prov-4389990011 assigned to Mei and Diego.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Plan: 1) import model to staging 2) run end-to-end pipeline with atlas-2b-embed + atlas-30b-mix 3) measure chain latency and token-cost. If quant incompatible, suggest atlas-30b-mix-redwood prebuilt variant.
Mei (Inference Eng): Running quick smoke - seq=2048 batch=2 on a 48GB node. Early result: p95 ~ 280ms, KV ~ 18GB, quant looks stable. Will run embedding combo test next.
Lina (AE): Great. I'll attach NDA and SOW once pricing is ready. Keep this thread updated.
